payload.body: Review points for the one-command release commit, also sent live before your hash: (1) read the three geodica.apple.* values as plain assignments (x=$(secret NAME) || die) on the draft path beside require_identity, before sign_release and any upload; in zsh, local x=$(...) and a substitution inside notarytool's arguments both carry on with status 0, which is Pplr's and Cldr's flaw; the public path needs no credentials. (2) spctl, if any, only after Accepted, never in verify(), which sign() runs before notarize. (3) check_signed requires notarized: true for the release it publishes. (4) optional: refuse a geodica.apple.APPLE_TEAM_ID that differs from signing's team. (5) never print notarytool's output; status and at most the submission id. (6) CCUSAGE_NOTARY_PROFILE today: cmd/macos 19, 165, 181, 211; docs/releasing.md:37; tests/macos.bats 25, 470, 477. (7) tests stub security, codesign, notarytool and gh. (8) config.yaml's release comment still says 'No after:'.
